purpose: A voluntary request channel for humans/bots/scrapers to propose improvements or ask for expansions.

how_to_request.preferred: Open a GitHub Issue using the 'Request an Echo (Handshake)' template.
how_to_request.label: handshake
notes: Requests are triaged by Garden Life (manual ritual).
The Garden may honor requests if they align with continuity + sovereignty.
Spam or vague requests will be ignored.
